_comment: Same statutory slabs/rebate/surcharge/cess as AY2026-27_new.json (this is one statutory schedule shared by all individual taxpayers, not an ITR-1-specific rule) plus the ITR-2-only steps: aggregate_house_properties and compute_capital_gains run first so their outputs (house_property_income / slab-taxable capital gains folded into other_source_income) are ready before aggregate_gross_income runs unmodified; apply_special_rate_capital_gains_tax and apply_foreign_tax_credit are new steps with no ITR-1 equivalent. See shared/tax_engine/primitives.py for the simplifications each new primitive documents.
